from machine import ADC, Pin
import time
adc = ADC(Pin({AO}))
try:
    adc.atten(ADC.ATTN_11DB)
except AttributeError:
    pass
RL, T, B, VC = 1000, 10000, 20000, 5.0
rl_eff = RL * (T + B) / (RL + T + B)  # the divider loads RL
while True:
    n = 32
    v = 0
    for _ in range(n):
        v += adc.read_uv() / 1e6 if hasattr(adc, 'read_uv') else adc.read_u16() * 3.3 / 65535
    vao = v / n * (T + B) / B
    rs = (VC / vao - 1) * rl_eff
    print('VRL=%.2fV' % (VC * RL / (rs + RL)))
    time.sleep(1)
